uniqueBuildNames.name: heavy hands
uniqueBuildNames.tier: attack-dominant (low-stat path when def not low)

buildDefinitions.name: equilibrium
conditions: all four combat skills (attack, speed, defense, luck) level >= FINAL_FORM_MIN (40)
buildDefinitions.leanSkill: null (deriveBuildLoopType returns null unless pure/combo thresholds met separately)

buildDefinitions.name: final form
conditions: NOT equilibrium (spread > 4 OR any skill below 40 — latter impossible if all >= 40, so spread > 4)
buildDefinitions.leanSkill: null unless pure/combo thresholds also met

buildDefinitions.name: glass cannon
conditions: defense is LOW: defense.level <= avg(other three levels) - LOW_SKILL_GAP (5)
buildDefinitions.note: Checked before pure/combo; attack-dominant glass build

buildDefinitions.name: heavy hands
conditions: defense is NOT low (fails isLowSkill for defense)
buildDefinitions.note: Same display name as pure attack PURE_NAMES entry but pure attack path is unreachable when gap>=2 (low-stat branch always wins)

buildDefinitions.name: deadbolt
conditions: attack is LOW: attack.level <= avg(other three) - 5

buildDefinitions.name: longshot
conditions: at least one of attack, defense, OR speed is LOW

buildDefinitions.name: heavy hands
conditions: UNREACHABLE when attack leads by >=2 (low-stat branch returns first)
buildDefinitions.note: PURE_NAMES.attack exists in code but dead for gap>=2

buildDefinitions.name: speed demon
conditions: defense is NOT low (else paper ghost)

buildDefinitions.name: wildcard
conditions: no other skill is low (else longshot)

buildDefinitions.name: assassin
conditions: top two skills are attack + speed (any order by level)

buildDefinitions.name: bruiser
conditions: attack NOT dominant with low def (that would be glass cannon earlier)

buildDefinitions.name: crashout
conditions: combo: attack+luck, second-third gap >= 3, no earlier match

deriveBuildNameAlgorithm:
deriveBuildName(skills) — priority order:
1. If all combat skills >= 40 → equilibrium (spread <= 4) OR final form
2. deriveLowStatBuild (requires top-second gap >= 2):
   - attack top + low def → glass cannon | attack top + def not low → heavy hands
   - defense top + low atk → deadbolt
   - speed top + low def → paper ghost
   - luck top + any other low → longshot
3. Pure: top-second gap >= 2 → PURE_NAMES[top] (immovable wall / speed demon / wildcard; attack unreachable)
4. Combo: second-third gap >= 3 → COMBO_NAMES[sorted pair]
5. blank slate

isLowSkill(skill): skill.level <= average(other three combat skill levels) - 5
rankedCombatSkills: sort attack/speed/defense/luck by level descending
deriveBuildLoopType:
deriveBuildLoopType(skills) — lean for counter loop (attack>speed>luck>defense>attack):
- Rank combat skills by level
- If top.level - second.level >= PURE_THRESHOLD (2): return top.skill
- Else if second.level - third.level >= COMBO_THRESHOLD (3): return top.skill
- Else: return null (blank slate — no typed lean for counters)

leanSkillFromSnapshot(buildType, skills) — ghosts/NPCs:
- If buildType non-null: lean = buildType
- Else: lean = highest-level combat skill (dominantCombatSkillFromLevels)

NPC display label (deriveNpcArchetypeLabel / deriveArchetypeLabel) — SEPARATE from build name:
- Ranks atk/def/spd from combat stats; if top-second stat gap >= 2 → pure label (heavy hands / immovable wall / speed demon)
- Else falls back to leanSkill → wildcard for luck; only 4 pure labels + blank slate (no combos/low-stat names)
edgeNote: supabase/functions/_shared/ghostHarvestUtils.ts uses DIFFERENT thresholds (PURE=3, COMBO=2) for deriveBuildLoopType only — client canonical is buildName.ts

exports.deriveBuildName: full display name + color from skill levels
exports.deriveBuildLoopType: dominant lean for counter system; null = blank slate
